title: "Ports of Animation Gallery"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: false
---

This is a gallery of data visualizations created using [animint2](https://github.com/animint/animint2).
```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, results="asis")
ahref <- function(href, text){
  sprintf('<a href="%s">%s</a>', href, text)
}
library(data.table)
```
```{r load_data}
meta.dt <- fread("meta.csv")
meta.dt[, img.png := sprintf("repos/%s.png", gsub("/", "_", viz_owner_repo))]
meta.dt[, viz.link := ahref(
  sprintf("https://%s.github.io/%s/", 
          sub("/.*", "", viz_owner_repo),
          sub(".*/", "", viz_owner_repo)),
  ifelse(file.exists(img.png),
         sprintf('<img src="%s" width="400"/>', img.png),
         viz_owner_repo)
)]
meta.dt[, repo.link := ahref(
  sprintf("https://github.com/%s", viz_owner_repo), "repo"
)]
meta.dt[, source.link := ahref(source, "source")]
meta.dt[, links := paste(repo.link, source.link)]
```
```{r display_table}
knitr::kable(meta.dt[, .(viz.link, title, links)])
```

[Download meta.csv](meta.csv)
